description: Open a URL in a real browser, run up to 20 steps (60 seconds at most), and return what happened: a timeline, screenshots and the final text. This acts on the live site: clicks and form submits are real. Nothing persists between calls, and typed text is not logged. Steps: {do: goto|click|type|press|wait|waitFor|scrollIntoView|mark, testid? | role+name? | selector?, text?, key?, url?, ms?, label?}. Uses 5 perceptions. Free keys get a monthly allowance.
